notes.title: Stream Animals - Paw-Linko and Mini Modes
notes.content:
Hey Friends!

We've added new game modes for Stream Animals! We've also polished up the session handling to make a streamlined experience.

[h2]Paw-Linko[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34505464/3298324a6c1b3fb97034602f86cccfaff67df950.gif[/img]
Animals fall through the Paw-Linko board to score points based on where they land. 

[h2]Mini Modes[/h2]
We've added shorter modes for even faster pace play. We will continue to add both kinds of modes.

[h3]Brawl[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34505464/5b26cb35767c1c7c1277a39bb7a8b8be1aa67bad.gif[/img]
You and your viewers descend into anarchy as you start a giant brawl on the map. Players are knocked out one by one until only one survives!

[h3]Losing Ground[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34505464/52e71ba4cccdfbb86614ff1df8b28ec2a1dfce9d.gif[/img]
You and your viewers wait in anticipation for the floor to pull a vanishing act. Only one player will survive the sudden game of "Now You See It, Now You Don't"!

[h3]Owlie's Knockout[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34505464/a55bdd037c43a3fec59c10aa7b26a5b96a2571a9.gif[/img]
Owlie swoops down like a feathered assassin, bonking out players one by one with a surprise headbutt, until there's just one bewildered player left wondering if they got outplayed by an owl!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Setting for players to join once during a session instead of every round.
[*] Fixes for placeholders sticking around when they shouldn't.
[/list]

Follow us on [url=https://x.com/smashboltgames]Twitter[/url] or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/streamanimals]Discord[/url] to stay updated!

- Smash Bolt Games

notes.title: Stream Animals - AFK Mode Update
notes.content:
Hey Friends!

I appreciate you all who are still playing the game. Over the years I've received a ton of feedback about how people play it. I originally developed it as something you would play as your main game during a stream but most people do it as more of an AFK/break time game. I've decided to embrace that. I've simplified and sped up the modes to hopefully make it more fun. This will seem like a drastic change but hopefully everyone will enjoy it. 

Now instead of choosing a single mode, you start a session and choose what modes to play. It will randomly cycle through the modes until you end the session. You can then see results for each match and a total for the entire session. 

I'm also planning on adding more quicker modes to the game that you can put in your session rotations. More details on that to come soon.

Follow us on [url=https://x.com/smashboltgames]Twitter[/url] or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/streamanimals]Discord[/url] to stay updated!

- Smash Bolt Games

notes.title: Stream Animals: Free For All - Survival Season 2 Announcement
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the start of our second Survival Season for Stream Animals: Free For All!
The season begins at 3 PM Central time on August 24th, 2022 and ends on September 21st, 2022.

Energy
We are using a basic energy system to keep things fair. Every time you join a ranked game, you use 1 energy. If you join multiple streams at a time or jump around frequently, you will lose energy. Playing several matches on a single stream will replenish your energy. Your score will not be counted toward the global leaderboard as long as you are at 0 energy.

Rewards
The top 3 players on the leaderboard at the end of the season will win a reward. Here are the rewards by rank:

1st - Penguin + 10000 Paws
2nd - 7500 Paws
3rd - 5000 Paws

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Stream_Animals]Twitter[/url] or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/streamanimals]Discord[/url] to stay updated!

notes.content:

Battle mode will turn the animals against each other in a more PvP focused mode. There will be more details soon on the new game mode!

[*] Reset Time - Resets the time to the default time for that phase.
[*] Add Time - Add 15 second increments of time.
[*] Subtract Time - Subtracts 15 second increments of time.
[*] End Timer - Skips to the end of the phase.
[/list]
